summary: PENSACOLA, FLA. - Ninth-seeded Coastal Carolina women's basketball (14-17, 7-11) will face 12th-seeded South Alabama in their first game of the Sun Belt Tournament on Wednesday at the Pensacola Bay Center in Pensacola, Fla.
